Operation

See table S15 VEHICLE RUNNING NOISE

, there was a whistling noise from the back.

Continue depending on the circumstances in which the noise occurs.

End of diagnosis

  • The noise increases when cornering.
  • The noise increases in vertical oscillation conditions.
  • Replace the wheel bearing on the side where the noise is loudest, positioning it with the magentic track towards the steering knuckle seeger (see warning below)Op. 4450C32 ONE FRONT WHEEL HUB BEARING, LH OR RH - REPLACE
  • Move on to Step 1

This bearing is used by the ABS active sensors to calculate the wheel speed. It should NEVER come into contact with metal shavings because they could alter the gap and prevent a correct reading from the sensor
